'''Version 1.9.1''' was an update for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on October 21st 2021.  It was 8.42 MB.

== ''Change Log'' ==

====<u>Fixes</u>==== 

*[[Rupter]] sometimes not attacking passive animals
*[[Call Of The Hive|Call of the Hive]] tags not working (new entities can now be assimilated)
*[[Sentient Greatbow]] wrong size when shooting
*Fixed Beckon Infestation crash:
